title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Urban Green Space and Public Health
prompt: In many rapidly growing cities, the amount of green space available to residents is decreasing, while rates of stress-related illness are rising. Some people argue that local governments should require developers to include a minimum amount of public green space in every new urban project. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this proposal? Write at least 250 words. In your answer, discuss the potential benefits and drawbacks of such a requirement, and give your own opinion on whether it is the most effective way to improve public health in cities.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请用英语撰写一篇至少250词的议论文。你需要明确表达你对“要求开发商在每个新城市项目中包含最低公共绿地面积”这一提议的同意程度，讨论其潜在好处与弊端，并给出你自己的观点：这是否是改善城市公共健康的最有效方式。注意：不要仅描述数据或图表；本题无图表。请确保文章结构清晰，包含引言、主体段落和结论，并使用恰当的论证和例子支持你的观点。
